summary: Commercial Invoice render failed — missing port_of_discharge in deal context
root_cause: Deal record was created without port_of_discharge being set. The CI Jinja2 template requires this field. Document generation failed at the rendering stage before any external system was called.

remediation_steps.description: Identify missing field from render error log
Patch deal record with correct port_of_discharge from PI
remediation_steps.result: port_of_discharge set to DEHAM from PI record

remediation_steps.description: Retry document generation for Commercial Invoice
